newsitem.title: USA: InterCel issues $300 mln in 144A debt.
newsitem.headline: InterCel issues $300 mln in 144A debt.

text.p: The following 144A debt issue from InterCel Inc was priced Thursday, according to a high-yield syndicate source.
The 10-year issue priced with an 11-1/8 percent coupon, compared with early price talk of 11-1/4 to 11-1/2 percent. The deal is prefunded with a three-year interest reserve.
InterCel, which operates cellular telephone and PCS systems, said it will use proceeds to build out its network in Kentucky and Tennessee.
Morgan Stanley & Co was the lead manager.
